subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client that receives the existing bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but this chooses a durable wire identity and extends a Gateway auth trust boundary; automation cannot decide that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow identity after rebase
options.body: Accept the proposed Even G2 node id and `even-hub`/`glasses` metadata contract, require the conflict rebase, and leave app placement and command policy to the related issue.

options.title: Rename or generalize before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to a maintainer-preferred durable id, such as an Even Hub family id, and refresh the external app/proof before merging.

options.title: Keep the identity external for now
options.body: Do not add a core bootstrap identity yet; keep Even Hub on generic node/plugin paths until maintainers choose a first-party or plugin ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow identity after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed Even G2 node id and `even-hub`/`glasses` metadata contract, require the conflict rebase, and leave app placement and command policy to the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Gateway auth/protocol and pairing paths touched by this decision.
